title: Luxury Goa Tour Packages
overview: Indulge in an exclusive coastal escape with Book My Bharat's Luxury Goa Tour Package. Curated for travelers who prefer comfort, privacy, and premium experiences, this tour blends luxury stays, private sightseeing, a grand dinner cruise, and thrilling water adventures - all wrapped in Goa's vibrant charm.

day_1.title: Arrival in Goa + Luxury Dinner Cruise
day_1.details: Welcome to Goa! Upon arrival at Goa Airport / Madgaon Railway Station, meet our representative and enjoy a private transfer to your hotel. Hotel check-in with welcome drink. Evening Double Deck Luxury Dinner Cruise (07:00 PM - 11:30 PM) - Panjim & North Goa route, Open deck under the sky, 2.5 hours cruising experience, 3 live dance performances, Live DJ & Bollywood music, Fun games with spot prizes, AC pickup & drop from Calangute/Candolim/Baga/Arpora.

day_2.title: North Goa Sightseeing (Private Basis)
day_2.details: After a lavish breakfast, explore the highlights of North Goa in a private vehicle: Fort Aguada, Candolim Beach, Baga Beach, Anjuna Beach (famous flea market Wednesdays), Vagator Beach. Evening at leisure or relax by the swimming pool.

day_3.title: South Goa Sightseeing (Private Basis)
day_3.details: Post breakfast, discover the serene and cultural side of Goa: Miramar Beach, Old Goa Churches, Shree Mangeshi Temple, Balaji Temple, Dolphin sightseeing (ticket at own cost), Evening boat cruise (ticket at own cost).

day_4.title: Luxury Adventure & Water Sports
day_4.details: Enjoy an action-packed adventure day: Pickup & drop by boat, Sightseeing by water, Jet Ski, Banana Ride, Bumper Ride, Boat Ride, Fishing (hand-made equipment), Life jackets for safety, Veg & Non-Veg lunch, DJ music on board.

day_5.title: Departure
day_5.details: After breakfast, check out and enjoy a private transfer to Goa Airport / Railway Station.

inclusions: 04 nights accommodation in 4 Star Goa hotel
Complimentary mineral water (1 bottle per day)
exclusions: Anything not mentioned in the inclusions
transfers: Airport/Railway transfers - Private, Sightseeing transfers - Private, Free Wi-Fi, Complimentary swimming pool

title: Kashmir Delight Tour Package – 6 Days / 5 Nights
overview: 3-Star Package | Private Travel | Ideal for Couples & Families

day_1.title: Arrival in Srinagar + Local Sightseeing
day_1.details: Pickup from Srinagar Airport & transfer to 3-star hotel. Explore Mughal Gardens: Nishat Bagh, Shalimar Bagh, Chashme Shahi. Walk through colourful Tulip Garden (seasonal). Enjoy Shikara Ride on Dal Lake. Visit Hazratbal Shrine.

day_2.title: Excursion to Sonmarg
day_2.details: Full-day trip to Sonmarg - The Meadow of Gold. Snow-covered peaks, meadows & scenic views. Return to Srinagar by evening.

day_3.title: Excursion to Gulmarg
day_3.details: Drive to Gulmarg - The Meadow of Flowers. Optional Gondola Cable Car Ride (direct payment). Explore lush meadows & panoramic Himalayas.

day_4.title: Doodhpathri + Houseboat Stay
day_4.details: Visit Doodhpathri - green meadows & milky-white river streams. Evening check-in at Deluxe Houseboat on Dal Lake.

day_5.title: Srinagar → Pahalgam + Sightseeing
day_5.details: Drive to Pahalgam - Valley of Shepherds. Visit Aru Valley, Baisaran Valley (Mini Switzerland), Betaab Valley.

day_6.title: Departure
day_6.details: Transfer to Srinagar Airport for departure.

inclusions: All sightseeing & transfers as per itinerary
